quotes.text: Some journalist wrote that I had 'baroque taste in hotel suites.' Baroque! Like that's a criticism. Yes, I had baroque taste. I also had a waterbed flown into Lyon, France. These are not mistakes. These are memories. You only get a certain number of memories and you might as well make them expensive.

quotes.context: Q Magazine interview conducted by Tom Hibbert at the band's Garden Lodge base, London, published in the May 1988 issue
